title: aiex Table Schema
description: Defines an AIEX Drizzle-backed schema dialect file for schema-to-SQLite migration.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file for IDE validation.

type.description: Must be 'object' — each file defines one table.

properties.description: Column definitions keyed by property name (camelCase).

required.description: List of property names that are NOT NULL.

examples.description: Few-shot examples used by AI extraction prompts.

name.description: SQLite table name in snake_case (lowercase letters, digits, underscores).

timestamps.description: Automatically add created_at and updated_at TIMESTAMP columns.

softDelete.description: Automatically add deleted_at nullable TIMESTAMP column.

properties.description: Column definitions. Keys must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

format.description: Semantic format hint that influences the SQLite column type.

primary.description: Mark this column as PRIMARY KEY. Only one per table.

default.description: Default value for the column. Type should match the column type.

pattern.description: Regular expression guidance for extraction and validation. Not emitted as a SQLite constraint because SQLite has no portable built-in REGEXP support.

enum.description: Enumeration of allowed values for this field. Emitted as a SQLite CHECK constraint.

examples.description: Example values for this field (injected into AI prompt).

xPrompt.description: Custom extraction instruction for this field, overrides the default AI prompt (prefixed with 'x-' to stay valid JSON Schema).

minLength.description: Minimum string length. Emitted as a SQLite CHECK constraint.

maxLength.description: Maximum string length. Emitted as a SQLite CHECK constraint.

minimum.description: Minimum numeric value. Emitted as a SQLite CHECK constraint.

maximum.description: Maximum numeric value. Emitted as a SQLite CHECK constraint.

nested.description: Create a separate related table instead of embedding as JSON.

foreignKey.description: Foreign key reference to another table.

properties.description: Sub-properties when type is 'object'. Ignored unless nested.enabled or drizzle.mode='json'.

items.description: Item schema when type is 'array'. Ignored unless items.nested.enabled.

columnType.description: Data type. Maps to SQLite as: string→TEXT, integer→INTEGER, number→REAL, boolean→INTEGER(boolean), object→TEXT(json), array→TEXT(json), null→TEXT.

formatType.description: Format hints: 'date-time' → INTEGER(timestamp), 'json' → TEXT(json), 'email'/'uri' → TEXT (no special mapping).

mode.description: Override Drizzle column mode. 'json' stores as TEXT(json), 'timestamp'/'timestamp_ms' as INTEGER, 'boolean' as INTEGER(boolean), 'bigint' as INTEGER(bigint).

output.description: Expected extracted output for the source text example.

enabled.description: Must be true to activate nested table creation.

relation.description: 'has-one' → one() relation, 'has-many' → many() relation. Only one level of nesting is supported.

column.description: Target column name in the referenced table.
